epics.title: Dossier Electronic Signature
epics.jtbd: When an Epidemiologist reviews a completed dossier, I want to logically sign it, so that my approval is officially recorded on the document.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: from 0% to 100% of required dossier signatures successfully recorded
requirements: R1: Add signature functionality to existing dossier API and data persistence layer

slices.title: Patch dossier signature functionality
slices.jtbd: When implementing the signature functionality for this epic, I want to patch the existing dossier controllers and entities, so that the dossier report is marked as signed and the signature is persisted without introducing new architectural layers.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an Epidemiologist user and a completed dossier report,
When they submit a signature request,
Then the dossier report is marked as signed and the signature is persisted.
Given an invalid signature request,
When they submit it,
Then the system rejects it and returns a 400 Bad Request.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: from 0% to 100% test coverage for signature edge cases

epics.title: Secure Session Termination
epics.jtbd: When an authenticated user logs out of the system, I want active authentication tokens to be invalidated, so that the session cannot be hijacked or reused.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: from 0% to 100% of logout requests resulting in token revocation
requirements: R1: Revoke active authentication tokens when the logout endpoint is called

slices.title: Patch logout endpoint to revoke tokens
slices.jtbd: When implementing token revocation for this epic, I want to patch the existing logout endpoint, so that authentication tokens are correctly invalidated upon logout.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated user with a refresh token,
When they call the logout endpoint,
Then the token is revoked and subsequent refresh attempts with it fail.
Given a revoked token,
When it is used to authenticate,
Then the system rejects the request with 401 Unauthorized.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: from 0% to 100% of tokens revoked on logout
